design_philosophy: Swiss Grid-first layout, rigorous high-contrast typography, monochrome base with vivid accents for statuses. No playful elements. Designed for speed, data density, and trust.

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous internal padding for containers (p-6, p-8), tight gaps for data correlation (gap-4, gap-6).
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid borders (border-border), sharp or max rounded-sm (4px) radii. No soft shadows. Use Grid Borders (The Technical Look).
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Flat Solid. Do not use glassmorphism for this data-heavy admin tool.

component_strategy.tables: Dense-but-readable. Compact padding, clear 1px bottom dividers, no zebra striping.
component_strategy.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. High contrast. Primary uses Klein Blue (#002FA7).
component_strategy.badges: Crucial for robot status. Use explicit labels paired with solid background colors (e.g., green for Running, yellow for Paused, gray for Idle).
component_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Left-aligned labels. 1px border for inputs, focus state must have 2px ring of primary color.
component_strategy.cards: Modular card system. 1px border, flat background. Highlight key metrics by scale.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2. Keep icons functional, avoid decorative icons.

animations.style: Minimalist. Instant feedback. Use subtle hover states (darken background, 1px lift) rather than bouncy effects.
animations.robot_status: Use a subtle pulsing dot animation for 'Running' status to indicate live background processing.

media.description: Minimalist TotyShop logo for the top-left navigation.
Admin user avatar for the top-right profile dropdown.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Text over status badges must be readable (use dark text on light badge backgrounds).
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='connect-bling-btn', data-testid='start-robot-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using pure React/Tailwind/Shadcn.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the pending products dashboard.
Include a real-time robot status panel (Idle/Running/Paused) with visual badges and a pulsing indicator when running.
Implement a UI section for raw vs cleaned title preview.
Add a file upload zone for the CSV pricing table.
Place the 'Conectar Bling' OAuth button prominently in settings or the header.
Display real-time logs (success/error lists) for product syncs.
All copy MUST be in Portuguese (Brazil).
